# 0.3.0 engineering baseline and qualification

[Русская версия](ru/0.3.0.md)

Consolidated on 2026-11-08 from the retired execution bundle at
`1ad9f8b483575c136c2eb5529869fb01fa53ad00`. Each row belongs to its named source,
binary, workload and date; none establishes verification of a later candidate.
The record preserves acceptance limits, failed results and recovery identities,
not a second copy of current configuration/API documentation.

## Build and test adoption

BUILD-SPOTBUGS-01/04/05, BUILD-CPD-02, BUILD-DEPS-03 and BUILD-PMD-06 completed
tool adoption and semantic triage. Their current scopes/counts/versions belong
to checked-in POM/build-support inputs and [build-quality](../../docs/dev/build-quality.md),
not historical rollout counts. SpotBugs acceptance must have per-finding rationale;
CPD/PMD counts are reviewed ratchets. Maven dependency analysis remains opt-in
advisory, without broad ignores or failOnWarning. Its initial 14 actionable POM
mismatches included removal of application→platform-errors and CSV→commons-io;
retirement intake must not reopen those resolved edges.

TEST-LIFECYCLE-01, COVERAGE-02, REGEX-03, WAITS-04, EXTERNAL-05, PILOTS-06,
CODECOV-07 and CONSUMERS-09 established the global controls. Per-module review
is separate. The original regex/CSV-metadata intake findings are now resolved;
existing [testing policy](../../docs/TESTING.md) owns the supported contracts.
Required project-owned status-policy activation was qualified in
[run 34679847573](https://github.com/xORex-LC/ioc-extractor/actions/runs/34679847573),
not inferred from current local code alone.

Historical diagnostic pilots were report-only weekly/manual adoption:

- Domain PIT: 105 KILLED + 2 TIMED_OUT + 8 SURVIVED = 115, NO_COVERAGE=0, 107 detected,
  about 53 s / 337 MiB peak RSS. Six feature-extractor survivors changed delimiters at
  index 0, outside the configured input corpus; two empty shortcuts were equivalent
  for that source. They were reviewed dispositions, not a general exclusion for
  later implementations. The two timeouts removed progress/empty-token guards.
- Stability: seeds 42/43/44, 147/135/157 s (453 s wrapper total), about 935 MiB peak RSS;
  exact then-current 261-suite union, no automatic retry. This is not today's suite
  count. Extending mutation scopes remains TOOL-5.

Full pilot/closure identities and dispositions remain in the immutable
[test adoption record](https://github.com/xORex-LC/ioc-extractor/blob/1ad9f8b483575c136c2eb5529869fb01fa53ad00/docs/worknote/0.3.0/evidence/test-quality-ledger.md)
and [build adoption record](https://github.com/xORex-LC/ioc-extractor/blob/1ad9f8b483575c136c2eb5529869fb01fa53ad00/docs/worknote/0.3.0/evidence/build-quality-ledger.md).

## Lifecycle and import qualification

The historical P6 lifecycle calibration source/JAR/guards and superseded public-ID
assertion are retained in [native capacity](../../docs/dev/native-capacity.md).
It used 100001 canonical rows, observed 10984.29 rows/s expiry drain and 571144 KiB
high-water; 2500 rows/s was a host-specific regression floor, not production SLA.
The current harness has the separate TOOL-10 failure; this historical pass does
not qualify a changed smoke/load runner.

Final packaged DATA qualification on 2026-09-01 used Ubuntu 24.04/systemd,
JDK 21.0.12 and production layout. It does not establish the Debian 11/12 platform
claim. Candidate source `3c02ba5c126c8afc272493f9395d6d07631bf720` had JAR SHA-256
`4c493d758291a198ddc8c900467979dc0e308e404eb441cd55e330d91f0368c2`.

| Scenario | Recorded outcome |
| --- | --- |
| Exact v0.2.0 start | Dataframe/service 3/7, 246 active rows, four revision 1 values and byte-exact mutable projection rollback oracles |
| Compatibility upgrade / rollback | Candidate 9/9 DISABLED_COMPATIBLE preserved rows/projections; matching old binary/config/unit/two-DB restore returned 3/7 and 246 rows, then candidate restore returned 9/9 |
| Explicit activation | Intake disabled; accepted identities plus stand-only fixed/2m, existing-records:expire archived 246 legacy rows without revision/export advance |
| First observation / expiry | Golden 20 rows, complete receipt, 120000 ms validity; expiry emptied active membership and projections without revision/export advance |
| Reappearance / identical delivery | New lifecycle ranges 267..286 then 287..306, revision 3/4 slices; sparse slots reused, identical CSV bytes still delivered for newer covered revision |
| Clean install / restart | Both schemas 9, ACTIVE fixed/12h+reject, import/sync disabled; golden 20 rows, stable lifecycle timestamps/IDs, healthy restart; two empty startup baselines distinguished from two revision 1 exports |

Final evidence HEAD `b3aee0a34a34514b8941a1f884536c76f8094e4a` passed verify at
`2026-09-01T12:40:46Z` with matching fresh context. This is distinct from the
packaged source. Lifecycle-owned schemas at qualification were 6/8, combined
candidate schemas 9/9; use current migration catalogs for current versions.
The pre-fresh installation recovery identity was
`/var/tmp/ioc-extractor-r030-data-before-fresh-20260901T120247Z`, with fresh release
`3c02ba5c126c-r030-data-fresh`. It is historical recovery evidence, not an assertion
that either path still exists.

Import bulk results were reported on Debian 12/ext4/Temurin 21.0.11, 512 MiB heap
and 384 MiB observed-heap ceiling. The load section did not unambiguously pin a
binary/source identity, so retain these as historical observations only:

| Profile | Accepted/rejected / mutations | Stage/promotion/total | Peak heap / RSS |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 100k insert | 100000 / 0 / 100000 | 5.489/16.183/21.672 s | 163.9/340.0 MiB |
| 1M mixed | 750000 / 250000 / 500000 | 55.906/163.546/219.453 s | 157.9/361.5 MiB |

The 1M promotion held the serialized writer for 163.546 s; FIFO fairness does not
preempt a transaction. Process wall times 27.58 s / 253.58 s include different setup
boundaries (1M includes 750k seed), and cannot be compared as pure import latency.
The historical [P9 record](https://github.com/xORex-LC/ioc-extractor/blob/1ad9f8b483575c136c2eb5529869fb01fa53ad00/docs/worknote/0.3.0/dataframe-import/p9-evidence.md)
also preserves rollback fixes for systemd-unit and POSIX ACL/xattr fidelity.

Samba P8/file-operation and a later Windows-host encryption result do not qualify
all server families. ADR 0025 H5 two-identity producer/service hardening was not
run and was explicitly deferred to OPS-8. Managed import remains disabled in the
fresh template until each source is qualified; polling does not replace ownership,
capability or exact-purge checks. Full [TTL packaged evidence](https://github.com/xORex-LC/ioc-extractor/blob/1ad9f8b483575c136c2eb5529869fb01fa53ad00/docs/worknote/0.3.0/data-ttl-01/evidence.md)
retains failed checker attempts as failures, not additional passes.

## Aggregate qualification and activation

The disposable P7 scenarios tested v9→v11 with empty aggregate/no backfill,
old-binary downgrade rejection, coordinated rollback, file/JDBC ledgers, managed
import success/quarantine, canonical receipt and ordered names. They did not
switch the root-owned systemd service. Implementation gate `3825523a` passed the
then-current verify/PMD scopes; its offline Dependency-Check 129/zero result did
not refresh NVD and is not current security evidence.

| P7 workload | Elapsed / write stage / RSS | Boundary |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 100k, 95% duplicates | 14067 ms / 10151187898 ns / 599724 KiB | baseline 14066 ms / 4157524625 ns / 530180 KiB; 5067 aggregate rows; elapsed ratio 1.000, write ratio 2.441 |
| 250k, 98% duplicates | 16083 ms / 8763274584 ns / 720876 KiB | 5051 aggregate rows; 65556 KiB headroom below 768 MiB MemoryHigh |

These are the reported P7 profiles, not a current general SLO or proof for every
later binary. Two old-baseline reruns failed with unsafe clock/high-water and
were excluded from performance samples; no host-clock movement was proven.
Whitespace-only field preservation is not blanket-qualified: OPS-14 remains open.

Live activation on 2026-09-26 is a separate identity:

| Identity | Recorded value |
| --- | --- |
| Source | `71296e2e095d008a7ae89193b334aaaa042466f2` |
| Release | `71296e2e095d-20260926T110020Z` |
| JAR SHA-256 | `25eea5947fa87a4761b579d66d3cb2b21c45a977afcdfea42844b2380996525e` |
| Applied/reviewed config SHA-256 | `6d2460ef1ec1d6a51666559504ce31f35f9585bf9435335c0ddb05528ea76fdd` |
| Coordinated rollback point | `71296e2e095d-20260926T110020Z-db.tar` and matching `-unit.service` |
| Previous config backup | `application.yml.backup-20260926T111325Z-806574` |

The transaction validated config, stopped service, backed up both databases/unit,
switched and passed health. Both schemas 11/WAL/foreign keys/quickCheck were healthy;
startup memory about 263 MiB / 269 MiB peak. Two real BIB-labelled deliveries preserved
four aggregate carriers and changed only the repeated IP name from order 1 to 2;
legacy artifacts retained keep-first sources. Two runs/registrations completed
and immutable export lag was zero. Managed import stayed disabled; its isolated
qualification did not broaden live source policy. The complete immutable
[aggregate evidence](https://github.com/xORex-LC/ioc-extractor/blob/1ad9f8b483575c136c2eb5529869fb01fa53ad00/docs/worknote/0.3.0/ioc-aggregate/evidence.md)
preserves scenario boundaries and failed attempts.

## Dependency and publication evidence

The dependency repair cherry-pick `98b3042c` was qualified at
`3307d1e2846890773bfca35f14c2097e8df20077`. [CI 34374281499](https://github.com/xORex-LC/ioc-extractor/actions/runs/34374281499)
and [Dependency Security 34374294199](https://github.com/xORex-LC/ioc-extractor/actions/runs/34374294199)
passed with 129 dependencies, zero unsuppressed findings and two reviewed JBIG2
false positives; report artifact 10113370027 (`dependency-check-report-16`). It
forward-ported released 0.2.1 repair `025b84fe567e90d4a4884f0667700a7b5c2b5fcc`;
that release source `6138464d8887b17da2574f9f4e5d8c9465e21d50` had
[scan 34349325936](https://github.com/xORex-LC/ioc-extractor/actions/runs/34349325936).
These exact-commit results do not supersede the later open screen below.

All six admitted 0.3.0-rc.1 library publication facts already have permanent
[component records](../release-notes/README.md). They retain original signed
bundles, Central deployments, protected runs and separate destination consumers.
Configuration protected CI recovery remains TOOL-8 despite successful corrected
local consumption; compatibility automation and independent versions remain
TOOL-6/9. ETL remains internal. No new publication is performed by this record.

## Preservation and future use

Temporary audit logs/census and obsolete designs are retired after their lasting
contracts move to owning documentation. Git keeps their versioned source at the
snapshot above. The 0.2.0 ignored release record required separate preservation
because it was never tracked. Counts and failed windows in historical evidence
must not be rewritten as current passes. This record is not release closure.
